metadata.title: Backlink Spam List: 581 Doorway Domains and Link Sellers with Public Evidence (Snapshot of 28 October 2026)
metadata.description:
What changed in this version (version 2, 21 November 2026). Version 1 was titled as a database of domains but held no domains: its only file described three "patterns". One counted 17,000+ websites carrying a shared checkout link as abuse, although that group also includes popular products linked from many sites; the other two ("expired domain doorway farm" and "hacked CMS checkout injection") had no source in the underlying work. This version replaces that file with the list itself.

581 domains that make or sell backlink spam, each with evidence anyone can check (a title shared with other listed sites, a redirect to the same storefront, a shared checkout link): 564 domains run as link networks (562 of them in 12 named networks) and 17 link sellers (9 of them the storefronts of those networks). A tool's spam score is not evidence on its own. The file is the list as published on 28 October 2026 at jasonzhu.ai/en/backlink-spam-list and github.com/zhuyansen/backlink-spam-list (list.csv at commit d60e53a), byte for byte; the live list can change, since anyone can report a site or dispute an entry there. The networks came to light while counting checkout links for a report on payment platforms.
